list.intro: A task is a reminder or scheduled work: when it's due, Wysebee Cloud runs its steps and posts the result to Activity. Ask your AI app to set one up through Wysebee Assistant.
list.emptyHint: Create one: give it a name, write its plan, and choose its browser.

form.name: Name
form.nameHelp: You write the plan and choose its browser and model next.

plan.title: Plan
plan.help: What this task should do, in Markdown — written as instructions to carry out. Each run sends it as the one message; the task works through it in the browser and finishes with a report.
plan.placeholder:
1. Check the sales dashboard for yesterday.
2. Summarise the three biggest changes.
3. Send me a notification with the summary.
plan.empty: No plan yet. A task cannot run without one.

general.confirmDelete: Delete the task "{{name}}" and its run history?
general.deleteHelp: Deleting removes this task and the history of its runs.
general.labelPlaceholder: A short display label for this task
general.readOnlyEditor: Read-only — you can only edit tasks you created.
general.readOnlyViewer: Read-only — your role can view but not edit tasks.

result.none: Not run yet. Press Start to run it now.
result.working: The agent is working on it…
result.noOutput: The agent finished without a written answer.
result.recordingGone: The recording folder is gone — it may have been moved or deleted.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.noSteps: No steps: when it's due, its plan is posted to Activity as a reminder.
schedule.via: Set up and changed from your AI app through Wysebee Assistant.

run.needsPlan: Write the plan on the Plan tab before running this task.
run.modelGone: This model is no longer available — choose another.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.intro: Reminders set with Wysebee, still to come. Cancel one here.
